Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa (Zimmermann Salesforce PWA Kit). Read-only investigation only — no edits.

Prior research this session already confirmed: `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` imports `useShopperBasketsV2Mutation as useShopperBasketsMutation` and `useShopperBasketsV2MutationHelper as useShopperBasketsMutationHelper` from `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`, alongside `useCustomerId`. I need the EXACT end-to-end wiring — from a real "Add to Bag" button click through to the actual basket mutation — so I can replicate the identical pattern for a new page (a homepage demo section using the shared `ZimmProductCard` organism, which takes an `onAddToBag?: () => void` callback prop).

Investigate and report back:

1. **Trace the real add-to-cart flow in `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` and `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`** (or wherever the actual click handler lives — it may be in a base component this project doesn't override, like the base `product-view`'s own add-to-cart button; check both). Report: what function is actually called when the real PDP's "Add to Bag" button is clicked, and read that function's full body. Specifically: does it call `useShopperBasketsMutationHelper`'s returned methods directly (e.g. an `addItemToNewOrExistingBasket`-style helper), or does it call `useShopperBasketsMutation('createBasket')`/`useShopperBasketsMutation('addItemToBasket')`-style raw mutations composed by hand? Quote the real code.

2. **What does the mutation actually need as input** — i.e. what shape of "item to add" does it require (a `productId`, a `quantity`, does it need the specific selected variant's ID vs. the master product ID, does it need `optionItems` for configurable products)? Trace this back to confirm exactly what data a caller needs to have on hand (from a `useProduct`/`useProductSearch` result) before it can call this successfully.

3. **Does it require an existing basket, or does it handle "no basket yet" (guest's first add-to-cart) automatically?** Report whether there's a `useCurrentBasket` (base hook, `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-current-basket`) call involved, and how a missing/empty basket is handled — does the helper create one automatically, or does calling code need its own explicit "create basket if none exists" branch first?

4. **Error handling and user feedback**: what happens in this codebase's real code when the add-to-cart mutation fails or succeeds — is there a toast/notification pattern already established (check `overrides/app/hooks/use-toast.ts`, Tier 2 per `protectedFiles.md` — read-only, don't suggest modifying it) that's already wired to real add-to-cart success/failure? Quote the real usage if one exists, so a demo page can reuse the identical toast pattern rather than inventing a new one.

5. **Is this whole flow guest-safe** (i.e. does it work without a logged-in customer, given this project's own known constraint that "Magento passwords were not migrated — all existing customers must reset at go-live," implying guest checkout/cart flows need to work independently of login state)? Confirm whether `useCustomerId`'s value being a guest ID (vs. a "real" logged-in customer ID) is handled transparently by the mutation helper, or if there's a specific guest-vs-logged-in branch in the add-to-cart code path.

6. **Any loading/pending state UI already established** for a real in-flight add-to-cart click (e.g. does the real "Add to Bag" button disable itself or show a spinner while the mutation is pending) — check the real button's JSX/props in whichever file has the actual click handler.

Report as structured findings with exact function names, exact code quoted verbatim (not paraphrased), and file:line citations. I'm using this to write a demo page's own `onAddToBag` implementation that calls the real mutation the same way, so precision on the actual working code beats a general description of how SFCC add-to-cart normally works.

8	import {isServer} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/utils'
9	import {isPickupShipment} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/shipment-utils'
10	import {isAddressEmpty} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/address-utils'
11	import {STORE_LOCATOR_IS_ENABLED} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants'
12	import {getConfig} from '@salesforce/pwa-kit-runtime/utils/ssr-config'
13	import {useMemo} from 'react'
14	import {useSFPayments} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-sf-payments'
15	
16	/**
17	 * This hook combine some commerce-react-sdk hooks to provide more derived data for Retail App baskets
18	 * @param id - basket id to get the current used basket among baskets returned, use first basket in the array if not defined
19	 * @param shouldFetchProductDetail - boolean to indicate if the baskets should fetch product details based on basket items
20	 */
21	export const useCurrentBasket = ({id = ''} = {}) => {
22	    const storeLocatorEnabled = getConfig()?.app?.storeLocatorEnabled ?? STORE_LOCATOR_IS_ENABLED
23	    const customerId = useCustomerId()
24	    const {confirmingBasket} = useSFPayments()
25	    const {data: basketsData, ...restOfQuery} = useCustomerBaskets(
26	        {parameters: {customerId}},
27	        {
28	            enabled: !!customerId && !isServer
29	        }
30	    )
31	    // Select the current basket, prioritizing confirmingBasket, then matching id, then first non-temporary basket
32	    // Filters out temporary baskets to prevent them from showing in the cart
33	    const currentBasket =
34	        confirmingBasket && !confirmingBasket.temporaryBasket
35	            ? confirmingBasket
36	            : basketsData?.baskets?.find((basket) => basket?.basketId === id) ||
37	              basketsData?.baskets?.find((basket) => !basket.temporaryBasket)
38	
39	    const memoizedDerived = useMemo(() => {
40	        // count the number of items in each shipment and rollup total
41	        let totalItems = 0
42	        const shipmentIdToTotalItems =
43	            currentBasket?.productItems?.reduce((acc, item) => {
44	                totalItems += item.quantity
45	                acc[item.shipmentId] = acc[item.shipmentId] || 0
46	                acc[item.shipmentId] += item.quantity
47	                return acc
48	            }, {}) ?? {}
49	
50	        // count the number on non-empty pickup and delivery shipments
51	        // also count the number of delivery shipments missing an address or shipping method
52	        let totalDeliveryShipments = 0
53	        let totalPickupShipments = 0
54	        const pickupStoreIds = []
55	        let isMissingShippingAddress = false
56	        let isMissingShippingMethod = false
57	        currentBasket?.shipments?.forEach((shipment) => {
58	            if (shipmentIdToTotalItems[shipment.shipmentId]) {
59	                if (storeLocatorEnabled && isPickupShipment(shipment)) {
60	                    totalPickupShipments += 1
61	                    pickupStoreIds.push(shipment.c_fromStoreId)
62	                } else {
63	                    totalDeliveryShipments += 1
64	                    if (isAddressEmpty(shipment.shippingAddress)) {
65	                        isMissingShippingAddress = true
66	                    }
67	                    if (!shipment.shippingMethod) {
68	                        isMissingShippingMethod = true
69	                    }
70	                }
71	            }
72	        })
73	        // sorting helps with query caching
74	        pickupStoreIds.sort()
75	
76	        // Calculate total shipping cost
77	        // Use currentBasket.shippingTotal to include all costs (base _ promotions + surcharges + other fees)
78	        const totalShippingCost = currentBasket?.shippingTotal || 0
79	
80	        return {
81	            totalItems,
82	            shipmentIdToTotalItems,
83	            totalDeliveryShipments,
84	            totalPickupShipments,
85	            pickupStoreIds,
86	            isMissingShippingAddress,
87	            isMissingShippingMethod,
88	            totalShippingCost
89	        }
90	    }, [
91	        currentBasket?.productItems,
92	        currentBasket?.shipments,
93	        currentBasket?.shippingItems,
94	        storeLocatorEnabled
95	    ])
96	
97	    return {
98	        ...restOfQuery,
99	        data: currentBasket,
100	        derivedData: {
101	            // Only true if a non-temporary basket exists (temporary baskets are filtered out above)
102	            hasBasket: !!currentBasket,
103	            ...memoizedDerived
104	        }
105	    }
106	}

12	/**
13	 * Hook to clean up temporary baskets
14	 * @returns {Function} cleanupTemporaryBaskets - Function to clean up temporary baskets
15	 */
16	export const useCleanupTemporaryBaskets = () => {
17	    const customerId = useCustomerId()
18	    const {data: basketsData, refetch: refetchBaskets} = useCustomerBaskets(
19	        {parameters: {customerId}},
20	        {
21	            enabled: !!customerId && !isServer,
22	            keepPreviousData: true
23	        }
24	    )
25	    const {mutateAsync: deleteBasket} = useShopperBasketsMutation('deleteBasket')
26	
27	    const cleanupTemporaryBaskets = async () => {
28	        if (customerId && basketsData?.baskets && basketsData.baskets.length > 0) {
29	            const temporaryBaskets = basketsData.baskets.filter(
30	                (basket) => basket.temporaryBasket === true
31	            )
32	            if (temporaryBaskets.length > 0) {
33	                // Clean up in parallel
34	                await Promise.all(
35	                    temporaryBaskets.map((basket) =>
36	                        deleteBasket({
37	                            parameters: {basketId: basket.basketId}
38	                        }).catch((error) => {
39	                            // Only log if it's not a "Basket Not Found" error
40	                            if (error?.response?.status !== 404) {
41	                                logger.error(
42	                                    `Error deleting temporary basket ${basket.basketId}:`,
43	                                    {
44	                                        namespace: 'useCleanupTemporaryBaskets'
45	                                    }
46	                                )
47	                            }
48	                        })
49	                    )
50	                )
51	                // Refetch after cleanup completes
52	                refetchBaskets()
53	            }
54	        }
55	    }
56	
57	    return cleanupTemporaryBaskets
58	}

import React from 'react'
import {
    Alert,
    AlertIcon,
    AlertTitle,
    CloseButton,
    Spacer,
    useToast as useChakraToast
} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

/**
 * Display a toast message on the screen.
 * This is a custom hook to handle showing toasts in the app, preventing duplicate toasts and to add action elements
 * to toasts when required. It supports all props supported by Chakra toast.
 *
 * @param {string} title Message text to be displayed in toast
 * @param {string} id - id provided to the toast to avoid duplicate toast ids, use it if multiple toasts are needed
 * @param {string} status Semantic state of the toast - success | error | info | warning
 * @param {node} action Optional component to be displayed in the toast (eg. Button to allow user to perform action)
 * @param {string} position The placement of the toast on screen
 * @param {number} duration The delay before the toast hides (in milliseconds)
 */
export function useToast() {
    const toast = useChakraToast()

    return ({
        title,
        description,
        status,
        action,
        position = 'top-right',
        duration = 5000,
        variant = 'subtle',
        isClosable = true
    }) => {
        let toastConfig = {
            title,
            description,
            status,
            isClosable,
            position,
            duration,
            variant
        }

        if (action) {
            toastConfig = {
                ...toastConfig,

                render: ({onClose}) => (
                    <Alert status={status} variant="subtle" borderRadius="md" py={3} width="sm">
                        <AlertIcon />
                        <AlertTitle> {title} </AlertTitle>
                        <Spacer />
                        {action}
                        <Spacer />
                        <CloseButton onClick={onClose} />
                    </Alert>
                )
            }
        }
        toast(toastConfig)
    }
}

275	   * Allows `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s primary/hover image crossfade for this variation. Suppressed
276	   * on Home per Dani Rivett's scope note, overriding the AC's unconditional framing — see the
277	   * module docblock's "Hover image-swap on Home" note. `false` here means a supplied
278	   * `hoverImage` is simply never swapped to, regardless of pointer capability.
279	   */
280	  showHoverImageSwap: boolean;
281	};
282	
283	/**
284	 * The extensibility AC's actual mechanism: every layout/visibility decision this organism makes
285	 * reads from this table, keyed by `variation` — adding a future variation means adding a union
286	 * member above and one row here, touching no JSX. `index.tsx`'s render body contains no
287	 * `switch`/`if` on `props.variation` anywhere (verify with
288	 * `grep -n 'variation ===\|switch (variation)' index.tsx` — zero hits).
289	 */
290	const VARIATION_CONFIG: Record<ZimmProductCardVariation, ZimmProductCardVariationConfig> = {
291	  home: {
292	    showBag: false,
293	    showAttributes: false,
294	    showSizeChips: false,
295	    hoverHidesPrice: false,
296	    hoverRevealsPrice: true,
297	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
298	    showRemove: false,
299	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
300	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
301	    showBadge: false,
302	    showHoverImageSwap: false,
303	  },
304	  plp: {
305	    showBag: true,
306	    showAttributes: false,
307	    showSizeChips: true,
308	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
309	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
310	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
311	    showRemove: false,
312	    hideBagOnMobile: true,
313	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
314	    showBadge: true,
315	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
316	  },
317	  wishlist: {
318	    showBag: true,
319	    showAttributes: true,
320	    showSizeChips: true,
321	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
322	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
323	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
324	    showRemove: true,
325	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
326	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: true,
327	    showBadge: true,
328	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
329	  },
330	};
331	
332	const messages = defineMessages({
333	  // Interpolated with the product name, matching ZimmProductPrice's WAS/NOW pattern — Media's
334	  // own `removeLabel` prop is a plain string, so the interpolation happens here, at the one call
335	  // site that actually knows the product name.
336	  removeFromWishlist: {
337	    id: 'product_card.remove.from_wishlist',
338	    defaultMessage: 'Remove {name} from wishlist',
339	  },
340	});
341	
342	const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCard';
343	
344	/**
345	 * Organism — the full product card, composing `ZimmProductCardMedia` and `ZimmProductCardContent`
346	 * across the `home` / `plp` / `wishlist` variations. See the module docblock above for the
347	 * confirmed Figma variation matrix and this component's own recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) for
348	 * the stretched-link and hover-reveal mechanics that live entirely in CSS, not in this render
349	 * body — both children are always rendered in full, with every one of their own sub-parts; CSS
350	 * alone decides what is visible for a given variation and pointer capability.
351	 *
352	 * @param props see `ZimmProductCardProps` — a discriminated union on `variation`.
353	 */
354	export const ZimmProductCard = (props: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
355	  const {
356	    id,
357	    href,
358	    name,
359	    headingLevel,
360	    primaryImage,
361	    hoverImage,
362	    images,
363	    currentPrice,
364	    originalPrice,
365	    isPriceLoading,
366	    isUnavailable,
367	    onNotifyMe,
368	    badge,
369	    variation,
370	  } = props;
371	
372	  const { onAddToBag, sizeChipValues, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect, colour, size, onRemove } =
373	    props as ZimmProductCardVariationFields;
374	
375	  const intl = useIntl();
376	  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];
377	
378	  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
379	  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
380	  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
381	  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
382	
383	  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
384	  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
385	  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
386	  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
387	  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
388	  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
389	  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
390	  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
391	  //
392	  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
393	  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
394	  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
395	  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
396	  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
397	  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
398	  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
399	  //
400	  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
401	  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
402	  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
403	  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
404	  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
405	  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean
406	  // for both the size-chip permanent-hide and this new price rule, since both only ever apply to
407	  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
408	  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
409	  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
410	  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);
411	
412	  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
413	  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
414	  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing
415	  // both conditions to the recipe — it only needs to know "hide this on mobile for this render",
416	  // not why.
417	  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));
418	
419	  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;
420	  const resolvedBadge = config.showBadge ? badge : undefined;
421	
422	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE, {
423	    hoverHidesPrice,
424	    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
425	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
426	    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
427	    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,
428	    // revealed on hover/focus-visible — every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference shows it
429	    // appearing only there) but unconditionally visible on touch (every Mobile Unavailable
430	    // reference — the only state a touch pointer ever sees, per the "Mobile has no Hover variant"
431	    // finding — shows it plainly, with no hover to reveal it). This flag is deliberately keyed off
432	    // `showNotifyMe` itself, not `variation`: the confirmed behaviour is identical across all
433	    // three variations, and the recipe's selector simply matches nothing when notify-me isn't
434	    // mounted at all.
435	    hoverRevealsNotifyMe: showNotifyMe,
436	    hideBagOnMobile: bagHiddenOnMobile,
437	  });
438	
439	  return (
440	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-card" data-product-id={id}>
441	      <ZimmProductCardMedia
442	        primaryImage={primaryImage}
443	        hoverImage={hoverImage}
444	        images={images}
445	        swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
446	        showControls
447	        badge={resolvedBadge}
448	        onRemove={onRemove}
449	        removeLabel={removeLabel}
450	      />
451	      <ZimmProductCardContent
452	        name={name}
453	        headingLevel={headingLevel}
454	        href={href}
455	        currentPrice={currentPrice}
456	        originalPrice={originalPrice}
457	        isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
458	        showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
459	        colour={colour}
460	        size={size}
461	        showBag={config.showBag}
462	        isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
463	        onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
464	        showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
465	        sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
466	        selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
467	        onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
468	        showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
469	        onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
470	      />
471	    </chakra.div>
472	  );
473	};
474	
475	export default ZimmProductCard;

149	 *

159	 * that prop exists (SFCC-236 Step 3): a grid of these on a PLP must not mount dozens of

161	 */
162	export const ZimmProductCardContent = ({
163	  name,
164	  headingLevel,
165	  href,
166	  currentPrice,
167	  originalPrice,
168	  isPriceLoading,
169	  showAttributes,
